protocol.pcre_cache: Warm for main series; separate fresh-process first requests
protocol.counter_method: user cycles/instructions for N jobs minus same startup/warmup with zero jobs, divided by N
protocol.wall_method: elapsed within process; complete jobs rotated evenly; no empty-loop subtraction
protocol.all_result_types: Matcher returns MatchResult objects; native/PCRE return associative arrays; normalization only in output checks
protocol.input_dictionary_sharing: Equal per-job dictionaries share one array outside timing; different per-order maps remain distinct

constructor_protocol.first: first constructor in a fresh PHP process after parsing; release/startup excluded; CPU and file caches are not cold
constructor_protocol.warm: construction and release plus common closure/loop cost
constructor_protocol.model: request minus worker is an estimate including wrapper differences, not the first constructor

metadata.order_protocol: paired reverse order; starting position rotates every pair
